name: DCP — Open activities by week recorded and escalation
description: Open collection activities grouped by the ISO week they were recorded in and by the platform supervisor-escalation flag. Age since recording is a fact; overdue is not, because no TAT start policy exists (KI-101), and the flag is reported, not derived — no escalation policy is configured (KI-104). Grain: ACTIVITY. Source: qdb_collectionactivity · createdon, qdb_supervisorescalated, statecode. Both CRMs. Narrowed by owner and activity type when supplied. DCP catalogue DCP-RPT-009.
fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_collectionactivity"><attribute name="createdon" groupby="true" dategrouping="year" alias="year"/><attribute name="createdon" groupby="true" dategrouping="week" alias="week"/><attribute name="qdb_supervisorescalated" groupby="true" alias="escalated"/><attribute name="activityid" aggregate="count" alias="activities"/><order alias="year"/><order alias="week"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/></filter></entity></fetch>
